# Scientific American

> > Scientific American (SciAm) is a leading science journalism publication by Springer Nature offering in-depth coverage of scientific discoveries, research, and innovation.

The site provides digital and print subscription access to award-winning science content, mobile apps for iOS and Android, and supports science communication initiatives including documentary filmmaking through programs like "The Protectors" wildlife conservation series.

## Subscription & Access

- [Be in Awe of the World. Read SciAm.](https://scientificamerican.com/getsciam): Scientific American subscription plans with digital & print options

## Documentary & Conservation Initiatives

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): Documentary funding call for wildlife conservation films, up to $80K
